  PROBLEM: The spec hard-codes `chore: sync main into <base ref>`, but the producer at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:14684 writes `chore: sync ${default_branch} into ${integration_branch}`.
  WHY: In a repo whose default branch is not `main`, every sync merge is refused as `foreign_commit`. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR (mapped to high); the other reviewers rated it NIT.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:87,366-367 | severity=low | confidence=3

  PROBLEM: D10 "Why" says the tested base differs from the tip only by main syncs, but condition 2 accepts any `[ai-merge-resolve]` commit by subject prefix alone, including non-merge resolver commits (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1775).
  WHY: Model-authored edits can pass the guard, so the stated guarantee is overstated.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:522 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The R7 risk example cites #9602's fix as a later sync, but the Context table (line 14) records commit `8a1664a5` as "Fixed by hand".
  WHY: Phase 10 would refuse a hand commit as `foreign_commit`, so the risk text misstates the guard's coverage.
- docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:364-366 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Condition 1 requires the first compare to be complete, but the spec sets no completeness check on the second compare (`<tested_base>...<default branch>`).
  WHY: A truncated default-branch listing can misclassify a genuine sync merge as `foreign_commit`, a false refusal.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:181-183 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `lint` and `static-checks` check-runs failed with `outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed` (tested_base ab6cdcb8f706, tip fc5f8284a7fc). They map to no hunk in this docs-only diff.
  WHY: `main` advanced after the merge ref was computed, so this is the R7 incident itself, and only a base sync clears it.
